src/hid/.description: HID module exists with stub implementations. mod.rs has config types, known devices list (Stream Deck variants). device.rs has HidDevice struct and HidDeviceManager trait with TODO comments for hidapi integration. mapping.rs has ButtonInputHandler with learning mode. actions.rs has comprehensive ButtonAction enum.

src/storage/hardware_store.rs.description: HardwareStore has complete CRUD methods for HID devices (save_hid_device, get_hid_devices, delete_hid_device) and button mappings (save_button_mapping, get_button_mappings, delete_button_mapping). Already integrated with database schema.

Cargo.toml.description: hidapi crate v2.4 is already added as dependency. No additional crate dependencies needed for HID support.

src/hid/device.rs.description: DefaultHidDeviceManager now tracks devices for auto-reconnect using auto_reconnect_targets HashMap keyed by identity_key (VID:PID:Serial or VID:PID:Path). Devices are tracked when opened via open_device() and untracked when closed via close_device(). The monitoring loop checks returning devices against this list.

src/hid/input.rs.description: HidInputReader now integrates with ButtonInputHandler via with_button_handler() builder method. When set, all RawButtonEvents are forwarded to handler.process_event() which handles mapping lookup and ButtonActionEvent emission. Learning mode captures button codes instead of emitting actions. Uses std::sync::Mutex (not tokio::sync::Mutex) for device_handles to match device.rs.

src/hid/streamdeck.rs.description: New Stream Deck protocol module with StreamDeckModel enum (Original, Mini, XL, MK.2, Pedal) and StreamDeckParser for stateful input parsing. Handles model-specific report formats: Original/Mini use 1-byte header, MK.2/XL use 4-byte header, Pedal has no header. Includes grid coordinate utilities and button labeling.

src/hid/generic.rs.description: New generic.rs module for USB button controller support. Implements GenericHidParser with four report formats: Bitmap (gamepad), BytePerButton (foot pedals), KeyboardScanCode (keyboard emulation), and ConsumerControl (media keys). Auto-detection via detect_report_format(). Known device profiles for common foot pedals (Microdia, VEC, Olympus). Human-readable button labels via keyboard_scancode_name().

src/hid/executor.rs.description: Created DefaultActionExecutor implementing ActionExecutor trait. Handles all ButtonAction types via dependency injection (WorkoutEngine, RideRecorder, AudioEngine, FanController). Uses AppContext struct for ride/workout state tracking. Emits ActionResult and ExecutorEvent via broadcast channels. LapMarker struct tracks lap times during rides. NavigationTarget enum for UI navigation events. Builder pattern for dependency injection (with_workout_engine, with_audio_engine, etc.).

src/workouts/engine.rs.description: Added restart_segment() method that resets elapsed time to start of current segment. Calculates segment start by summing previous segment durations, resets total_elapsed_seconds, clears extension and ramp state, and emits IntervalRestarted event.

src/recording/recorder.rs.description: Added LapMarker struct and lap tracking to RideRecorder. LapMarker captures lap_number, elapsed_seconds, distance_meters, avg_power, avg_hr. Methods: add_lap() creates lap with calculated averages since last lap, get_laps(), has_laps(), lap_count(). Lap markers cleared on start() and discard().
